edit.description: Early same-clock historical forecasts, smoothly approach frozen static teachers
edit.interpolation: smoothstep; phase is normalized over observed score nodes; no extrapolation
edit.normalization: dose is normalized over actual score nodes to a mean of one

failure_modes: Affinity response: the edit may not improve decoded final affinity because coordinate contrasts are untyped proxies and no decoded affinity labels are present in role input; a null or negative affinity change would falsify the benefit claim.

Gradient cancellation: the observed-forecast and static-teacher component gradients may partially cancel, so a changed scalar reward value alone would not prove changed injection; gradient-direction and delivered-dose checks are required.
Temporal attribution: if S1 does not outperform S2_constant_blend and S3_static_to_observed_control at fixed dose, the benefit is not attributable to timing.

Support: the soft_mass curve has 4 sign changes and 1 strong sign conflict across 14 independent batches and its cubic polynomial is not accepted, so the staged-relevance contrast may not reproduce across independent batches.
Strain and structural validity: must be reported separately from affinity; a coordinate improvement with degraded validity or strain would not establish an acceptable edit.
rationale: H001 states that landmark_00_soft_mass carries a time-dependent contrast: early and late score nodes sit below the window mean while the mid-window plateau sits above it, consistent with a staged reward that weights early same-clock historical forecasts and relaxes toward static teachers. The delivered curve handle for landmark_00_soft_mass (Eef4385e476674774) and its trend row (E2e106e083189d150) support a non-monotone, sign-changing profile across the observed window, and the clock metadata (E0857891f4effbfe1) confirms the observed score nodes span [0.0,0.49] with no extrapolation licensed. The objective metadata (Eaa4bda02c9a2c3a1) confirms affinity is primary and coordinate contrasts are proxies. Among the registered reward-route choices, S1_observed_to_static is the only one that implements the early-observed-to-late-static relevance schedule H001 describes; S2_constant_blend removes the staging and S3_static_to_observed_control reverses it, so both serve as controls rather than the hypothesis-consistent edit. Dose is held fixed (dose=[1,1,1]) and delta is unchanged, so this is a reward-lane edit only.
